rationale: 7.0.0 renames the shared commands, config file and ESLint helper from releaseready to buildproveship (RRDPLAT-135) and adds two error-level guardrails, hand-written-xml-parser and legacy-path-name (RRDSCRUM-437). Both new rules were measured on origin/main of every inventory repo; the XML rule has no hits, and the path rule hits are versioned contract files that each consumer lists in contractPaths with a reason.
